customManagers.description: Trusted-images inventory upstream tracking: captures ref, tag and digest from every inventory/<app>/image.yaml entry so Renovate opens PRs on upstream version bumps AND same-tag digest drift. Versioning is loose, never default docker, so the internal -bocklabs.N revision suffix orders numerically. PRs automerge once the validate / inventory check passes.
Manage SecObserve GitHub Actions separately because SecObserve uses vYYYY_MM release tags which are incompatible with Renovate's native GitHub Actions digest lookup.

packageRules.description: Disable Renovate's native GitHub Actions handling for SecObserve. SecObserve vYYYY_MM releases are managed by the custom regex manager so SHA pinning can be retained without native digest lookup failures.
